sync.description: Sync your workouts, health and nutrition data (intake log, presets and goal) and settings across devices through your own Google Drive. Data lives on your Drive; no Kaiord server is involved. If two devices each hold a nutrition goal for the same athlete, the most recently saved one is kept.
sync.plaintextWarning: Your saved AI API keys will be uploaded without end-to-end encryption. Enable encryption below to protect them.

profileChoice.title: Which athlete is this device for?
profileChoice.body: Your Google Drive already holds several athletes. Pick the one that should receive what you recorded on this device; nothing is synced until you choose.

sync.connectFailed: Could not connect Google account — please retry.
sync.syncFailed: Sync failed — your data is safe and stays local.

privacy.infoNoServer: Your records sit in this browser, unencrypted — deleting the site data deletes them. Kaiord runs no server that keeps a copy. The only things that leave are what you route to a connection, what you send to your AI provider, and the Drive snapshots if you turn cross-device sync on.
privacy.infoExtension: Garmin, Train2Go, WHOOP, Tanita and TrainingPeaks connect through the Kaiord extension, which rides the session you already have open on each site. Your passwords never leave your browser.
privacy.infoApiKey: intervals.icu connects with an API key you paste. It is stored encrypted in this browser and sent only to intervals.icu.
privacy.infoLlmKeys: LLM API keys are sent directly to the provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google) — Kaiord does not receive or relay this data.
privacy.infoNotResponsible: We are not responsible for credential security on your device.
privacy.analyticsOutro: to track aggregate usage (page views, workout generation, exports). No cookies are set and no personal data is collected.
privacy.exportHint: Downloads your workouts, health, nutrition and settings data as a JSON file, unencrypted. API keys, connections and sync state are not included. Keep the file somewhere safe.
privacy.exportFailed: Could not export your data — please retry.
privacy.importHint: Merges a Kaiord backup file into this browser without deleting anything here: the newer copy of each record wins, and what you deleted after the backup stays deleted. API keys are not in the file — add them again in the AI settings.
privacy.importChooseProfile: This backup holds several athletes. Which one should this browser's data join?
privacy.importSummary: Backup imported: {{added}} added, {{updated}} updated, {{notRestored}} deleted after the backup (not restored).
privacy.importInvalid: This file is not a Kaiord backup.
privacy.importNewerApp: This backup was made by a newer version of Kaiord. Update the app and try again.
privacy.importFailed: Could not import the backup — please retry.
privacy.clearAllHint: This removes all stored API keys from your browser. Keys already uploaded to your Google Drive by cross-device sync are not deleted by this action.
privacy.clearKeysFailed: Failed to clear API keys — please retry.

wipeDialog.title: Delete all my data?
wipeDialog.body: This deletes every athlete, workout, health and nutrition record, connection, AI key and setting stored in this browser. It cannot be undone: export a backup first if you may want any of it back.
wipeDialog.drive: Your copy in Google Drive is not deleted. Sync is turned off in this browser; if you connect it again, that copy comes back here.
wipeDialog.syncing: Wait for the sync in progress to finish.
